title: One Day Youth Retreat 2026
theme: "WHY SHOULD WE NOT ABIDE IN CHRIST?"
scripture_verse: "Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me." — John 15:4
introduction: The One Day Youth Retreat 2026 is a sacred spiritual gathering organised under the Church of South India (CSI), Diocese of Karimnagar, Aler Group Church Council, Mothkur Pastorate at C.S.I. Wesley Church, Palliwada. Grounded in the divine motto 'CALLED. CHOSEN. LOVED. SENT.' and the theme 'WHY SHOULD WE NOT ABIDE IN CHRIST?' (John 15:4), this retreat empowers young believers through vibrant worship, biblical exposition, and fellowship.
programme_overview: A full-day itinerary from 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM starting with morning reception and opening prayer, uplifting congregational worship, keynote messages from anointed servants of God, youth fellowship, and personal prayer dedication. Lunch follows.

highlights.title: Vibrant Praise & Worship
highlights.description: Telugu and Hindi congregational worship songs exalting our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

highlights.title: Empowering Biblical Messages
highlights.description: Practical Bible teaching on abiding in Christ (John 15:4) by our Chief Guest and Guest Speaker.

highlights.title: Youth Fellowship & Action Songs
highlights.description: Interactive group sessions, joy-filled action choruses, and community building in Christ.

highlights.title: Fellowship Lunch
highlights.description: Complimentary morning tea, refreshments, and fellowship lunch provided on campus.

guidelines: Bring your printed Bible (Telugu or English), a notebook, and a pen.
Arrive promptly before 8:30 AM to participate in the opening prayer and worship session.
Maintain decorum, modesty, and reverence inside the church sanctuary.
Come with an open, expectant heart to receive God's blessings and abide in Christ.
